key_insight: Ecdysis improves LLM agent harness training by aggregating failures across instances to separate model-specific errors from true harness flaws, enabling more targeted and efficient repairs.
engineering_relevance: For agent builders, this means faster harness iteration with better generalization, reducing wasted tuning on single-task failures and improving deployment reliability.
method: Batch-level cross-instance failure aggregation to find recurring failure patterns
Failure-Driven Collaborative Refinement to diagnose failure causes and refine harness specs
Bias adaptation toward harness-level repair rather than model-specific accommodation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 1.84x faster harness training and an 18.56% improvement in reasoning accuracy versus existing harness evolution methods.
watch_item: Cross-task failure aggregation may miss rare but important edge-case failures, so the diagnosis quality depends on diverse evaluation instances and careful implementation.
paper_title: Ecdysis: Efficient and Effective Training of Runtime Harnesses for LLM Agents
